title: Competitive Parity and Trustworthy Public Beta
description: Transform Boreal from a feature-rich local runtime into an externally installable, multi-agent, multi-machine, independently verifiable public beta at peer level with Beads, Backlog.md, OpenSpec/Spec Kit, Spec Kitty, Maestro, and Task Master while preserving Boreal's source-to-decision-to-work-to-proof differentiation.
acceptanceCriteria: Every child sprint is closed with descendant evidence, passing verification, and Git checkpoint coverage.
A new user can install Boreal and complete the five-command golden path on macOS, Linux, or Windows in under five minutes.
Two independent clones can collaborate, resolve conflicts, recover interrupted synchronization, and preserve every durable record.
Closeout distinguishes agent-reported, Boreal-witnessed, human-attested, and external-CI evidence and can require current witnessed proof.
Independent review, acceptance, resumable merge, and spec/change interoperability are available as first-class workflows.
At least ten agent environments install and validate through one manifest-driven adapter registry.
An external extension can add a workflow, policy, and validator without modifying Boreal core.
A five-user unassisted beta meets the defined install, return-use, and comparative-preference thresholds before public release.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
